answer.thought: The gardens close at nineteen thirty, giving me fifty-six minutes of quiet before I must decide on the IIC. I am too tired to walk further, so I will sit on the bench and look at the pages of the Right. The tension between the state as ethical actuality and the reality of this place is still unresolved, and the silence here is the only place I can hold it without flinching.
